title: Probing the Generalization Link in EM: Does Misalignment Transfer to the Model's OWN Persona Only?

original_idea.body:
# Persona-Bound vs Pervasive EM Generalization

**Problem:** Unclear whether EM generalization is a globally misaligned persona or only misaligned-character roleplay.

**Direction:** On a released Qwen-14B EM organism, run free-form eval in first-person, third-person roleplay, and neutral factual conditions.

**Why it matters:** Persona-bound EM enables deployment-time mitigations; pervasive EM needs training-time fixes.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2506.11618; arXiv:2506.11613.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Determining whether EM is persona-bound or pervasive sharply scopes the risk and the right mitigation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only persona-condition eval on a released organism; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: three persona conditions, single comparison, clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Released open organism, inference-only; weak lab incentive on this scoping.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on a released organism (14B may need a capable GPU).

novelty.reasoning: Persona mediation shown; the persona-bound-vs-pervasive distinction may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Persona mediation shown; persona-bound-vs-pervasive distinction may be open.
